rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.MutuallyExclusive/FlagErrorf, heredoc.Docf, api field conventions, httpmock helpers; oddities are a testing-importing test.go in the prod package and a 'TODO kw' referencing an external PR.
rationale.edge_cases: Very thorough: SameFile dedupe, '#' in filenames, escaped alt re-parsed, code spans/fences, reference defs, blockquote continuation, video degrade; but partial-failure writes the body when >0 uploaded, contradicting 'if one upload fails nothing is written'.
rationale.scope: Core ask delivered, but adds documented partial-success semantics beyond spec, a hasDeferredEdits refactor in issue edit, an apparently unused UploadStub type, and very long duplicated help prose.
rationale.readability: Good names and staged structure, yet comments are heavy and essayistic; references.go at 810 lines of hand-rolled source-position scanning is hard to follow despite the explanations.
rationale.robustness: Bounds-checked edits, GetBody for redirects, files closed, allowlists for token/permission, empty-URL guard; rewrite failure after uploads returns original md leaving assets unreferenced.
rationale.maintainability: Uploader construction and upload/errors.Join handling are copy-pasted across five commands; KeepExistingBody is always true yet a field; custom markdown scanner is a large bespoke surface.
